items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: One time, we played a battle of music with Duke in Philadelphia

ctx.x: He is from Long Branch or Seabright, if I'm not mistaken, and he was the only drummer then, especially Black drummer, working with all the white groups there in Jersey.
This is before he was with Duke?

Oh yeah, way before. And I was still in school when Sonny was playing around, so I used to see Sonny Greer and see him up there throwing his sticks around and just doing everything; he looked good and he was a great showman.
